Package com.composum.platform.models.annotations

Class InternationalizationStrategy.I18NFOLDER

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.platform.models.annotations.InternationalizationStrategy.NONE
      • com.composum.platform.models.annotations.InternationalizationStrategy.I18NFOLDER
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    InternationalizationStrategy
    Enclosing interface:
    InternationalizationStrategy
    public static class InternationalizationStrategy.I18NFOLDER
extends InternationalizationStrategy.NONE
implements InternationalizationStrategy
    Default internationalization strategy used in Composum Pages: uses ResourceHandle.getInherited(String, Class) to retrieve inherited values and retrieves internationalized properties from locale dependent folders below i18n/ at the current resource. When a i18n-able property name is stored at a resource at path, it is looked up at the following paths, in that order (the examples refer to a hypothetical locale with language=de, country=DE, variant=SN):

    1. path/i18n/language_country_variant/name, for example path/i18n/de_DE_SN/name
    2. path/i18n/language_country/name, for example path/i18n/de_DE/name
    3. path/i18n/language/name, for example path/i18n/de/name
    4. path/name, for example path/name

    If Property.inherited() is true and none of these are found, this process is performed on parent resources as well, as determined by Property.inheritanceType().

        Retrieves the internationalized value for name (may be an attribute name or a relative path) from resource. See detailed description at InternationalizationStrategy.I18NFOLDER.
        Specified by:
        getInternationalized in interface InternationalizationStrategy
        Overrides:
        getInternationalized in class InternationalizationStrategy.NONE
        Parameters:
        resource - the resource for which the properties are wanted, not null
        name - the name of the property - may be a relative path as well
        valueClass - the class the value is to be converted into, not null
        beanContext - if available, the BeanContext
        request - if available, the request one could get the locale from
        locale - if available, the locale
        parameters - the annotation parameters about the value
        Returns:
